urban.desc: built-up areas (>= 30 % of the tile built-up)

dry_floodplain.desc: dry land within 3 km of mapped surface water (flood-plain context)

mountain_shadow.desc: steep terrain imaged at low sun (terrain shadow)

snow.desc: snow- or ice-covered land (L2A scene class snow >= 30 %)

cloud_shadow.desc: land with cloud shadows (L2A scene class shadow >= 5 %)

rule: static maps only; no water index or model output; >= 25 km from GDACS pool; one tile per 2-degree cell
